name: Thork
summary: At the Crossroads, Thork keeps watch over the settlement’s defenses. He sends Horde adventurers against raiders and works to keep supply routes open.

sections.title: Commander of the Crossroads
sections.body: Thork commands the defenses at the Crossroads, where roads link Durotar, Mulgore, and lands beyond. The town faces threats from every side. Quilboar raids, centaur attacks, and harpies on the prowl stretch his forces thin. Thork calls on capable travelers to meet dangers his guards cannot handle alone.

sections.title: Securing the Borders
sections.body: Thork’s watch reaches beyond the Crossroads walls. He sends scouts and messengers north to the Mor’shan Rampart, where they report to Kadrak. The northern and eastern routes carry supplies through the Barrens. Keeping those roads open sustains the Horde’s presence across the scrublands.

sections.title: Threats Inside and Out
sections.body: Thork thanks travelers who strike at the leaders behind the Razormane raids. Mangletooth, a captive quilboar, betrays his tribe by helping them attack its leaders. When travelers bring Lok Orcbane’s head to the Crossroads, Thork thanks them for weakening the assaults on Horde supply routes.

faq.answer: Thork commands the Crossroads defenses in the Barrens. He organizes the town’s protection and works to keep supply caravans safe.
Thork stands outside near the center of the Crossroads, coordinating guards and giving defense orders.

faq.q: Why is the Crossroads so vulnerable to attack?
faq.answer: The Crossroads lies at an open meeting of major trade routes in the Barrens, with little stone fortification. Hostile Razormane quilboar, Kolkar centaur, and Alliance scouts threaten its borders, so the settlement needs constant watch.

faq.q: What is Thork's relationship with Mankrik?
faq.answer: When Mankrik asked for soldiers to hunt quilboar and search for his lost wife, Thork refused. His limited troops had to guard the outpost and its supply caravans.

faq.q: How does Thork coordinate with other Horde posts?
faq.answer: Thork sends messengers and fighters to Kadrak at the Mor’shan Rampart to report on the northern border and watch Ashenvale’s border.

faq.q: What threats does Thork deal with?
faq.answer: Thork faces marauding quilboar warbands that disrupt trade and steal supply crates. He also thanks travelers who defeat the leaders behind the raids.

angles.text: If you come from Durotar or Mulgore as a member of the Horde, reporting to Thork is an important step in proving yourself a protector of Kalimdor.
As an orc, you know the hard duty of defending the Horde’s newly conquered lands in Kalimdor from hostile neighbors.
As a warrior, you can value Thork’s focus on supply routes, sound patrols, and stopping physical threats before they reach the town walls.
